label: EXISTENCE_8 as a real predicate: a positive reality coextensive with EXISTENCE_8 at a world
definition: ExistenceFeature m p w f: the feature f of the reality profile p is existence at w taken as a real predicate, i.e. a positive reality (a perfection, a determination that can belong to a concept) had by exactly the candidates existing at w. ExistenceIsRealPredicate says some feature is; Kant's thesis (existence is not a real predicate) denies it.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred (Kant A598/B626 and Descartes' Meditation V are navigation). It reuses the reality profiles and world-relative existence of TruthCore.German.Kant.CosmologicalInference. Kant's positive account of existence as positing corresponds to EXISTENCE_1 (instantiation of a concept), not to this sense. The real-predicate control shows that this sense is what makes 'most real implies exists' valid.
